value: North wing offices (zones 201-210) consistently run 2-3C hotter after 14:00 due to direct sun exposure through floor-to-ceiling windows. Recommend proactive cooling ramp-up at 13:30.

Primary chiller draws 15% above nameplate current during first 3 minutes of startup. Not a fault - confirmed by Carrier technician on 2026-01-20. Do not raise alerts for transient overcurrent under 5 minutes.
Grant (facility manager) prefers bullet-point summaries with ZAR cost estimates. Dislikes tables longer than 5 rows. Always lead with the most critical issue.

October to March (SA wet season): building humidity often exceeds 60% by 10:00. HVAC dehumidification mode should engage at 55% threshold instead of default 65%. Adjust back to 65% threshold April-September.
Generator requires minimum 10-minute cooldown before restart after emergency shutdown. Attempting faster restart risks thermal shock to turbocharger. This overrides any automated restart logic.

B1 parking CO2 sensors read higher than actual due to proximity to loading bay exhaust. True CO2 levels are typically 15-20% lower than sensor readings. Account for this offset when evaluating ventilation alerts.
Building runs with relaxed setpoints on weekends (26C cooling, 18C heating) to save energy. Security guard post on L0 zone 001 is excluded - must maintain 22-24C for guard comfort.
